title: Fort Collins Home Rebates 2026: Efficiency Works Heat Pump, Insulation and Windows
desc: Fort Collins home rebates for 2026 from Efficiency Works: heat pumps up to $3,000, insulation by the square foot, windows, water heaters, induction, a $2,000 bonus and double for rentals.
badge: Heat pumps up to $3,000, plus a $2,000 bonus
lead: Fort Collins Utilities customers use Efficiency Works, a program that also serves Estes Park, Longmont and Loveland. It has the widest list of rebates of the five Colorado cities we cover, with offers for heat pumps, insulation, windows, water heaters, induction ranges and electric panels. A bonus pays $2,000 for combining projects.
cards_heading: What is open for Fort Collins homes in 2026
cards_intro: We read Efficiency Works' January 2026 sheets and its rebate page on October 5, 2026. Applications are due within 45 days of purchase or project completion, and funding is limited.

cards.title: Heat pump
cards.note: Ducted $1,500 or $2,000 per unit, ductless $500 per ton ($1,000 replacing baseboard), ground-source $3,000.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: $600 replacing electric or propane, $400 replacing gas. ENERGY STAR certified.

cards.title: Insulation and air sealing
cards.note: Air sealing $310 to $770. An Efficiency Works assessment comes first.

cards.title: Windows and doors
cards.note: ENERGY STAR Northern climate zone products. A combustion safety test is required.

cards.title: Bundling bonus
cards.note: Heat pump plus an envelope measure within six months.

cards.title: Rental bonus
cards.note: Rental properties served by Fort Collins Utilities get twice the retrofit rebate, with a 12-month lease and approval before work.

cards.title: Smart thermostat
cards.note: Up to $75 for electric baseboard thermostats, minimum two.

cards.title: Induction range or cooktop
cards.note: Replacing gas, with before and after photos. Up to $50 replacing electric. Heat pump dryers up to $100.

cards.title: Electric panel upgrade
cards.note: 200-amp or larger panel, only with a heat pump, induction, EV charger, solar or battery project. A load sharing device pays $250.

cards.title: State heat pump discount
cards.note: $83 for a heat pump water heater. Off your invoice from a registered contractor.

cards.title: State income-based rebates (HEAR)
cards.note: Up to $14,000 per household while open. Larimer County was in the Front Range region, now closed.

sections:
The American Community Survey (2020 to 2024) counts 74,558 homes in Fort Collins. About 52% of households own and 48% rent. About 52% of homes are detached houses and 9% are in buildings of two to four units. Only 31% were built before 1980 and 37% in 2000 or later.

Nearly half of households rent, and the program has a rental bonus for that reason: double the standard retrofit rebate for properties served by Fort Collins Utilities, with a 12-month lease and approval before work starts.
Why the bonus changes the order

The $2,000 bundling bonus pays when you finish a heat pump and an envelope measure (air sealing, windows or doors) within six months of each other. Rebates and bonus together cannot exceed the cost of the work. If you can afford both, plan them together: book the assessment, do the insulation and air sealing, and then size the heat pump. See our insulation page and heat pump page.

Retail items such as thermostats, induction ranges and heat pump water heaters are bought anywhere and claimed after. Retrofit work such as heat pumps, windows and insulation must be done by an Efficiency Works listed service provider on a home at least a year old. A package above $2,500 needs approval before work begins, or it is capped at $2,500. Efficiency Works says it may change measures without notice.

About 66% of Fort Collins households heat with utility gas and 31% with electricity. Efficiency Works pays double the standard ductless rate for replacing electric baseboard heat, and $600 instead of $400 for a heat pump water heater replacing electric or propane. The Xcel Energy rebates on our Denver page do not apply to Fort Collins Utilities customers.

The federal credits ended after 2025. The Colorado Energy Office closed its single-family income-based program in August 2026. The state's invoice discount remains at no less than $333 for an air-source heat pump. Efficiency Works also lists an income-qualified CARE program for qualified renters and single-family owners, which we have not read in detail, and Flex programs for thermostats and electric vehicles.
claim_heading: How to claim Fort Collins rebates
claim_steps: Check that Fort Collins Utilities is your electric company.
Book an Efficiency Works assessment if you plan insulation or air sealing.
Choose an Efficiency Works listed service provider for retrofit work.
Get approval before work if your package will be over $2,500.
Apply within 45 days of purchase or finishing.
faq: What rebates can a Fort Collins homeowner get in 2026?

Efficiency Works pays for heat pumps, heat pump water heaters, insulation, air sealing, windows and doors, thermostats, induction ranges, heat pump dryers and panel upgrades. A $2,000 bonus applies to combined projects, and the state adds an invoice discount.
Is Xcel's rebate available in Fort Collins?
Xcel's rebates are for Xcel customers. Fort Collins Utilities customers use Efficiency Works.
Yes, double the standard retrofit rebate for properties served by Fort Collins Utilities, with a 12-month lease and approval before work.
How long do I have to apply?
Within 45 days of purchase or project completion.
Is the state's income-based program open?
No. The single-family program is closed.
